name: Half-cosine Squared Splatting
definition: A splatting technique using a half-cosine squared function as the radial basis function, requiring a correction factor to scale the 3D covariance matrix.
summary: Half-cosine Squared Splatting is a 3D Gaussian Splatting technique using a bounded half-cosine decay that accelerates training and reduces memory by requiring fewer primitives for the same opacity.
